features: Powerful 40W DJ Tower Speaker with Free Wireless Mic & Multi-Connectivity – Experience booming sound with this compact yet high-performance 40W speaker, perfect for parties, karaoke, and home entertainment. Enjoy crystal-clear audio with Bluetooth 5.0, FM radio, USB/SD card playback, and AUX input for versatile connectivity. The included wireless microphone lets you sing or host effortlessly, while the handy remote control ensures easy operation from a distance. Its rugged yet sleek design makes it ideal for indoor and outdoor use, delivering rich, distortion-free sound whether you're DJing, gaming, or streaming music.

Thunderous Bass from a Compact Solid Wooden Cabinet (8mm MDF Construction) – Don’t let its small size (39cm H x 16cm W x 25cm D) fool you—this speaker packs a punch with deep, resonant bass thanks to its premium 8mm solid wooden enclosure. Engineered for enhanced acoustic performance, the sturdy MDF construction minimizes vibrations for clearer mids and highs. Perfect for small spaces without sacrificing sound quality, it’s a portable yet powerful audio solution for home theaters, parties, and outdoor gatherings.

Premium 2.1 Sound System with Dual 80mm Midrange Drivers & 110mm Subwoofer – Immerse yourself in studio-quality audio with a dual 80mm midrange speaker setup for detailed vocals and instruments, paired with a powerful 110mm subwoofer for deep, punchy bass. Whether you're listening to music, watching movies, or gaming, this HI-FI tower speaker delivers balanced sound with crisp highs and rich lows. The advanced driver configuration ensures minimal distortion at high volumes, making it a top choice for audiophiles and casual listeners alike.

Multi-Functional Entertainment Hub – Bluetooth, FM, USB, SD, AUX & Remote – Transform any space into an instant entertainment zone with this all-in-one speaker system. Stream wirelessly via Bluetooth 5.0, tune into FM radio stations, or play music directly from USB flash drives and SD cards. The 3.5mm AUX input allows wired connections to TVs, laptops, and smartphones, while the included remote offers hassle-free control. Ideal for house parties, weddings, and outdoor events, this versatile DJ speaker ensures non-stop music with studio-grade clarity.

Sleek, Portable & Durable Design for Home & Outdoor Use – Combining style with substance, this modern tower speaker features a sleek, space-saving design that fits any decor. The ultra-portable build (lightweight yet sturdy) makes it easy to carry for picnics, beach trips, and backyard parties. Built with high-quality components, it offers long-lasting durability and consistent performance even at high volumes. Whether for personal use, DJ gigs, or karaoke nights, this trendy, high-fidelity speaker delivers powerful sound in a compact package.
